workflow.title: Declare
workflow.detail: Write a supported material response or coupled weak form in Python.

workflow.title: Check
workflow.detail: Exercise tangent consistency and an example-specific independent oracle.

workflow.title: Generate
workflow.detail: Emit deterministic, self-contained fixed-form Fortran for review.

workflow.title: Compile & assemble
workflow.detail: Call the generated boundary and, for UELs, inspect residual and tangent blocks.

workflow.title: Run in Abaqus
workflow.detail: The user owns the mesh, steps, loads, controls, units, outputs, and scientific claim.

scopes.title: Material response
scopes.description: Finite-strain and small-strain paths for supported constitutive declarations, including state threading and Abaqus stress/tangent conventions.
scopes.boundary: A generated UMAT does not choose an Abaqus element, procedure, mesh, load history, or material calibration.

scopes.title: Coupled-field elements
scopes.description: Supported field, interpolation, balance, material, and local-variable templates for coupled residuals and tangent blocks.
scopes.boundary: This is not a compiler for arbitrary variational expressions and does not generate a complete Abaqus analysis.

examples.title: Neo-Hookean
examples.summary: Finite-strain stateless response with Cauchy stress and Jaumann DDSDDE conversion.
examples.evidence: Closed-form uniaxial/shear oracle, deterministic generation, compiled stress parity, and a finite-difference tangent check.

examples.title: Small-strain J2
examples.summary: Stateful radial return with elastic/plastic branches and engineering-shear handling.
examples.evidence: Exact shear oracle and a compiled 40-increment stress/STATEV path.

examples.title: Viscoelasticity
examples.summary: History- and time-step-dependent response with tensor state packed into STATEV.
examples.evidence: Exact discrete-relaxation oracle and a compiled 30-increment history.

examples.title: Ogden spectral path
examples.summary: Explicit eigenspace reconstruction, including repeated-spectrum tangent states.
examples.evidence: Eigenspace-independent oracles, compiled parity, and distinct/repeated-spectrum tangent checks.

examples.title: Thermo-mechanical Quad4
examples.summary: Two-field displacement-temperature element with cross-field blocks and node-interleaved DOFs.
examples.evidence: Closed-form force and heat-balance checks, compiled assembled parity, and a current-source Abaqus 2022 smoke solve.
examples.boundary: One-element integration check; not a general thermo-mechanical validation.

examples.title: Mixed-order Quad8
examples.summary: Quadratic displacement with bilinear corner temperature and deformation-dependent pulled-back flux.
examples.evidence: Independent flux-ratio oracle, assembled/compiled tangent checks, and a current-source Abaqus 2022 smoke solve.
examples.boundary: One-element integration check; not a paper-scale analysis.

paperEvidence.title: Stabilized mixed u–θ Tet4
paperEvidence.summary: Quarter-block compression using the kinematically stabilized equal-order tetrahedron of Scovazzi, Zorrilla, and Rossi.
paperEvidence.result: Retained full-run value: u₃ = −0.696244 mm at full follower pressure, within about 1% of the published n=16 curve.
paperEvidence.freshCheck: The current source regenerated and compiled; the tracked n=16 deck passed datacheck. A generated n=2 model completed 24 increments with zero cutbacks.
paperEvidence.boundary: The full n=16 analysis was not repeated in the 2026-07-30 fresh-clone pass.

paperEvidence.title: Diffusion-driven morphing sequence
paperEvidence.summary: A grooved sheet evolves with a Hex8 displacement–chemical-potential UEL and one condensed pressure variable per element.
paperEvidence.result: Six tracked Abaqus/CAE frames and reduced ODB snapshots document the completed production sequence.
paperEvidence.freshCheck: The exact archived production source and deck passed a fresh Abaqus 2022 datacheck; the current generator also passed its local-pressure contract checks.
paperEvidence.boundary: The production analysis was not rerun. A shared-node native C3D8 companion mesh contributes stiffness, and its sensitivity audit remains pending.

paperEvidence.title: Mixed-order gel bilayer
paperEvidence.summary: Plane-strain swelling with quadratic displacement and chemical potential, bilinear corner pressure, and 28 element DOFs.
paperEvidence.result: The public checkout retains the accepted deck and four historical Abaqus/CAE exports at 0, 30 min, 1 h, and 6 h; it does not retain a full-run solver log or machine-readable result record.
paperEvidence.freshCheck: Current-source one- and two-element gel smoke decks completed in Abaqus/Standard 2022 with zero cutbacks.
paperEvidence.boundary: The full bilayer was not rerun. Regenerating its deck requires the separately obtained Chester–Di Leo–Anand mesh seed; their original supplemental files are not redistributed.

paperEvidence.title: Phase-field corrosion comparison
paperEvidence.summary: Three-field displacement–phase-field–concentration Quad8 declaration compared with the Cui–Ma–Martínez-Pañeda reference implementation.
paperEvidence.result: Tracked reduced reference histories and fields support the retained code-to-code comparison record.
paperEvidence.freshCheck: Both current Fortran variants regenerated and compiled; the tracked full deck with the fresh diagonal source passed Abaqus 2022 datacheck.
paperEvidence.boundary: The full analysis was not rerun. The comparison mesh has third-party lineage; its precise BSD notice and redistribution status remain an open provenance item.

validation.boundary: A datacheck verifies input processing, compilation/linking, procedure compatibility, and model setup. It does not establish nonlinear convergence or reproduce a published result. Full corrosion, n=16 Tet4, gel-bilayer, and pasta analyses were not repeated in this pass.
